thread:
alex: Heads-up — planning a coordinated version bump for the upcoming release (target v1.14.0). Need quick confirmations from API, runtime, console, SDK leads.

alex: Cutoff is EOD Wed for feature merges, freeze Thu morning. Can teams confirm bump readiness? :calendar:

samir: Runtime: I need to check a quantized kernel change. If it lands today we might need a small patch bump.

priya: SDK: small breaking change in request serialization landed yesterday, but we've toggled it behind a flag. Can do a minor bump for SDKs and patch if needed for back-compat.

chris: Console: changelog entries ready, just waiting on the runtime compatibility note. Also need the exact semver we're bumping to (1.14.0 or 1.14.0-rc?).

alex: Let's keep core artifacts at 1.14.0 final. RC flow only if runtime patch forces a delay.

release-bot: deploy-freeze-enforced: Code freeze starts 2026-04-07T09:00Z. Please avoid merges after that unless tagged with #release-exception.

june: Quick question: for cross-repo tags, do we use git tags like "redwood/api@v1.14.0" or repo-specific tags?

alex: Repo-specific tags. We'll add a release manifest (small JSON) in the release branch pointing at all repo tags. I'll draft it.

samir: Runtime update: kernel change looks safe but uncovered a perf regression on long-seq tests. If we can't fix by tomorrow, prefer to revert and ship on time — opt for patch later.

priya: SDK owners: I'll cut SDKs to 1.14.0 today and publish staged packages to the internal registry. Will link install commands here.

chris: Console will include runtime compatibility banner if runtime is >=1.14.0-patch. Otherwise we show the "pending compat" banner.

alex: Checklist I'm tracking: 1) tag API/runtime/console/sdk -> 1.14.0; 2) release manifest in release branch; 3) changelogs merged; 4) smoke tests green; 5) publish SDKs; 6) post-release notes. Mark when done.

priya: SDK publish in progress: running `npm publish --tag rc-internal` then promote after smoke pass.

samir: Perf regression mitigation took longer, I reverted the kernel PR. Runtime is back to green. Will run the long-seq perf job one more time.

alex: Great — that sounds like go. If everyone is green by EOD Wed I'll cut tags Thu morning. I'll ping here when I create the release branch.

chris: Ping me when branch is cut, I'll coordinate console rollout (canary + 5% then full).

june: I'll update the release manifest once tags exist and add the HA note for Dedicated capacity.

release-bot: reminder: create release checklist issue: https://git.internal/redwood/releases/issues/new?template=release-checklist

alex: Thanks all. Short follow-ups only in this thread — we want a clear audit trail. :white_check_mark:
